<subject>GRIDMASTER/CLEARNET AVAILABILITY</subject>
<body>
To all GRIDMASTER users:

The GRIDMASTER system will be brought down on a nightly basis between 12:01 AM – 4:00 AM CET for nightly processing. The system will be available in the morning after that time, with positions primed by 5:30 AM.

CLEARNET will be available during these times.

Please call the GRIDMASTER Hotline (+49 40 789 2146) if you have any questions or concerns.
</body>
